label: Conservación total sin sumar transferencias internas

label: Principal anterior a todos los pagos de la fecha de cierre

scope_note: Five supplied zero-rate scheduled principal payments occur strictly before cut; the sixth coincides with cut and is not separately deducted again from the stated payoff
